meta.parties: Madar Saibo Et Al v. Sirajudeen Et Al

rules.statement: A fraudulent deed, unlike a deed executed by a person not competent in law to enter into contracts, is valid until it is set aside or cancelled, and when it is cancelled, the cancellation refers back to the date of the deed.
rules.supporting_quote: "A fraudulent deed, unlike a deed executed by a person not competent in law to enter into contracts, is, under the Roman-Dutch law, valid until it is set aside or cancelled, and when it is cancelled, the cancellation refers back to the date of the deed."
